༄༅/ /zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang shes rab bzang*// dzñā na sid+dhi chos kyi blo gros dang*// bzhad pa rdo rje bsod nams rin chen zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje rgyal po rgyal dbang rat+na shrī// bsod nams grags dang rdo rje grags pa'i mtshan// rin chen seng ge grags pa bsod nams zhabs// rdo rje rin chen rdo rje rgyal po dang*// chos kyi rgyal po bshes gnyen don grub rgyal| |nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ngag dbang rgyal mtshan zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa rig 'dzin chos kyi rgyal// ras chen rat+na rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan// sna tshogs rang grol dpal gyi rgya mtsho'i zhabs// mchog grub rgyal po mkhan chen bi da'i mtshan// rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs// rgyal ba kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gzhan yang bka' bab nyams kyi brgyud pa yi// bla ma rnams dang yi dam chos srung bcas// mchog gsum skyabs gnas thugs rje can rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gus pa mchog gis gsol btab mthus// dbang bzhis sgrib bzhi sbyangs nas sku bzhi yi// smin grol sa bon dam pa legs btab nas// snod bcud rten dang brten par 'char ba dang*// 'pho chen rlung sems rnam rtog nyi zla'i 'gros// zung 'jug dhū tir sgra gcan gyis za zhing*// gtum mo'i bde drod lhan skyes rtogs pa dang*// ma dag sgyu ma'i rang mtshang myur mthong nas// dag pa gnyis ldan sgyu ma'i skur grol zhing*// rmi lam 'khrul ba'i rang ngo shes pa dang*// 'od gsal chos sku'i rang zhal myur mthong zhing*// bar dor nges pa lnga ldan 'char ba dang*// 'pho bas dag pa mkha' spyod rab bgrod de// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*| |'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog
/sogs brjod/ ces nā ro chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa dge'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
